newsitem.title: USA: U.S.JET FUEL DIFFS EASE MODESTLY IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: U.S.JET FUEL DIFFS EASE MODESTLY IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: U.S. spot fuel differentials eased Friday as buyers backed out the market, forcing sellers to lower offers.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures shed 1.01 cents to settle at 54.29 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf prompt 54-grade jet fuel traded at 0.65 cent over the September NYMEX, down about 0.15 cent from levels seen late Thursday, according to traders.
In New York Harbor, prompt 54-grade barrels were talked at about 3.15 cent over the NYMEX, the low end of the trading range seen Thursday, players said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
